entries.name: play
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game UI utility icon for Starfall, isolated transparent PNG. Create ONE centered PLAY symbol: a bold right-pointing triangular arrow with subtly rounded corners, broad luminous ivory pearl-enamel front face and a restrained warm antique-brass beveled rim, a thin deep midnight-navy recessed edge giving crafted depth. Premium hand-painted 3D observatory instrument material; polished but not plastic, matching a jewel-like navy-and-brass lantern game emblem. Readable immediately at 24–32 display pixels. Face directly toward camera, orthographic, no perspective lean. Soft top-left light, small restrained specular highlights only on the object. The triangle fills about 75 percent of a square canvas with generous transparent margin on every side; center by visible mass. Actual transparency everywhere outside the icon. No circle, button tile, bezel or backing plate around it. No scene, floor, shadow beyond the silhouette, outer glow, sparkle, stars, text, letters, numerals, logo or watermark. One icon only; not a sheet or mockup.

visual_review.notes: Pearl front faces, warm brass bevel, navy recessed accents, transparent margins. No external button tile or surrounding glow.

entries.name: haptic
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game UI utility icon for Starfall, isolated transparent PNG. Create ONE centered HAPTIC FEEDBACK symbol: a short upright pearl resonator crystal, a bold symmetrical faceted elongated hexagon with broad ivory pearl-enamel faces and restrained warm antique-brass beveled edges. One short gently curved vibration mark on each side, exactly TWO marks total, separate from the crystal with transparent gaps. The marks are thick ivory-pearl strokes with slim brass edges, symmetrically flanking the middle of the crystal; they do not form a circle or frame. A subtle deep midnight-navy recessed side facet gives crafted depth. Keep the central crystal and its two short vibration marks balanced as one clearly readable icon at 24–32 display pixels. Premium hand-painted 3D observatory instrument material; polished but not plastic, matching a jewel-like navy-and-brass lantern game emblem. Face directly toward camera, orthographic, no perspective lean. Soft top-left light, small restrained specular highlights only on the object. The entire icon including its two marks fills about 75 percent of a square canvas with generous transparent margin on every side. Actual transparency everywhere around the crystal and marks. No phone, bell, human hand, circle, button tile, bezel or backing plate. No scene, floor, shadow beyond the silhouettes, outer glow, sparkle, extra stars, text, letters, numerals, logo or watermark. One icon only; not a sheet or mockup.

technical_review: Every selected output is RGBA with alpha extrema 0 and 255. Low-alpha residue (values 1–7) extends beyond the visible silhouettes; threshold-8 bounds are recorded for visual normalization. Masters remain byte-identical to generated originals.
validation_environment: Bundled workspace Python with Pillow; system python3 lacked Pillow, so its inspection attempt stopped before copying or modifying any PNG.
